title: Ripple adds support for institutions to access RWA perpetual swaps
snippet: Ripple, a leading provider of blockchain solutions across traditional and digital finance, today announced that Ripple Prime has launched support for real-world asset (RWA) perpetual swaps. Institutional clients including Virtu are now trading RWA swaps with respect to more than 100 reference market
